QUOTE: "pointers start as platform.c:44-45 stubs: calloc stub returns NULL, free stub does nothing" and "Stub behaviour when `MEMORY` is on but nothing was installed: every allocation fails with NULL."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the uninitialised default calloc pointer is a stub returning NULL and the default free stub does nothing, so allocation fails instead of falling back to libc.
